name: Default
shortDescription: Web server for a Cooklang recipe collection: browse, edit and scale recipes, plan meals, and keep a shopping list and pantry.

alerts.message: Visitors can browse recipes without signing in; changes need a user. Sign in as admin with the COOK_ADMIN_PASSWORD value from the environment variables. It only applies on the first deploy: later, manage users with cook server user add|passwd|remove in the cookcli container terminal.
